body:
> Handoff · Alphalete · 2026-10-01

# Summary
A consolidated handoff covering every Alphalete Code session from May 18 to Oct 1 2026 (182 sessions found, 100 reviewed in full). Five parts: decisions in force, status by workstream, pending tasks with check dates, recurring workflows, and where files live. Decisions are folded into [Alphalete - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-alphalete-decisions-and-rules).

# Status by workstream (as of Oct 1)
- **Indexing:** 108 of 111 tracked URLs indexed (Page Sheet v24, Sep 29). GSC Pages (data to Sep 21): 113 indexed, 13 Discovered-not-indexed (down from 25), 11 crawled-not-indexed, 36 noindex (correct), 3 404s. `/services/` hub indexed by Sep 25. 0 broken links on Sep 22.
- **City pages:** 44 root city pages, one primary service each; 44 hand-written OTTO titles/metas (Aug 17); mobile legibility CSS; mojibake icons fixed on 41 pages. Positions Sep 25: Parker 9 to 11, Littleton 10.7, Denver 12.7 to 13.3, Colorado Springs main term 17.5, Woodland Park about 4.
- **Service pages:** `/services/` rewritten (about 1,466 words) with lead form and FAQ schema; commercial hub rewritten Sep 25 (some items held for the Agency owner); hydro page now the Colorado Springs hydro page; camera page new title.
- **Blogs:** about 50 published. Sep 23: 42 posts got focus keyword, title, meta and intro/H2 alignment, all re-requested by Sep 24. Wins: camera CS blog 28 to about 949 weekly impressions; CIPP vs pipe bursting 0 to about 200. Problem: `/blog/what-is-trenchless-sewer-repair/` fell from about 25 to about 70 on Sep 16 after its rewrite (old title not backed up).
- **Google Ads:** Aug 11 to Sep 7, $3,335.68 spend, 247 clicks, 21 conversions, CPA $158.84; Denver more efficient. Possible double counting (WhatConverts plus GHL form); "WhatConverts Call Conversion" recorded 0 conversions in 2026.
- **Outreach and authority:** Instantly campaigns (see [Alphalete - Instantly Outreach 2026-06-24](lib:brain-alphalete-instantly-outreach-2026-06-24)); GSC shows 1 external link; no BBB/Yelp/YP for the trenchless brand.
- **GBP (location 93169):** unverified, wrong services and category, Pacific timezone, statewide area, 15 to 16 reviews with 0 replies. On hold with the Agency owner.
- **Tracking:** tags healthy; GA4 organic Jun 1 to Sep 22 had 7 generate_lead, 6 form, 4 phone events but none marked as key events.
- **Case study (US):** June 16 clicks / 2,352 impr / pos 37.8 / 28 page-one queries, to Sep 1 to 22: 21 / 16,251 / 22.3 / 125 (116 excluding junk).

# Pending check dates (from the file)
| Date | Task |
|---|---|
| Oct 2 | Recheck what-is blog 12681; if still about 70, bring a title test |
| Oct 6, Oct 9 | Weekly tracker snapshot; indexing check |
| Oct 12 to 16 | Full GSC re-measure; what-is blog and /denver/; camera and scope blogs; commercial hub; hydro page |
| Oct 19 to 23 | Woodland Park and blog checks; 42-post meta pass; Sep 25 city links |
| Nov 9 | 60-day strategy review |

# Waiting on the Agency owner or Client
Official NAP phone; commercial hub held items; services list (pipe bursting, backwater valves, epoxy lining, water line, 24/7, true radius); Orangeburg draft facts; CIPP cost draft 14301; warranty wording; case study ROI data; GBP name and ownership question.

# SEO Specialist decisions open
Residential page retarget (week 1 of content queue); rewrite 3 posts that kept old keywords; Sep 24 baseline fix list (long titles, salesy metas, stale focus keywords); typed phone numbers in about 31 blog bodies; keep or remove about 30 zero-demand small-town pages; junk rankings from city boilerplate; GA4 key events and Ads double counting.

# Artifacts listed
Page Sheet, Change Tracker, Keyword Opportunity Sheet, content strategy, commercial hub rewrite, Case Study Scrapbook, Search Visibility Report, Blog Keyword Review, Action Pack, Search Playbook, Sep 11 audit dashboard, Sep 16 SEO Performance Report (claude.ai artifact links in the source file).
